response.sql:
WITH status_rates AS (
  SELECT s.healtheval AS status,
         SUM(sc.scancount) AS total_scans,
         SUM(sc.gbsize) / NULLIF(SUM(sc.spanmin), 0) AS gb_per_minute
  FROM scans AS sc
  JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref
  GROUP BY s.healtheval
),
with_average AS (
  SELECT status, total_scans, gb_per_minute,
         AVG(gb_per_minute) OVER () AS average_gb_per_minute
  FROM status_rates
)
SELECT status, total_scans, gb_per_minute,
       gb_per_minute - average_gb_per_minute AS above_average
FROM with_average
WHERE gb_per_minute > average_gb_per_minute;

assumptions.assumption: GB per minute is calculated for each health status as the ratio of the summed non-NULL file sizes to the summed non-NULL scan durations; rows missing either value are excluded from both sums. A zero total duration yields a missing rate. The average is the unweighted average of the non-NULL status rates.

alternatives.interpretation: Calculate a per-scan GB/minute rate for rows with both values present, then average those rates within each status (instead of dividing summed GB by summed minutes).
alternatives.sql:
WITH status_rates AS (
  SELECT s.healtheval AS status,
         SUM(sc.scancount) AS total_scans,
         AVG(sc.gbsize / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS gb_per_minute
  FROM scans AS sc
  JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref
  WHERE sc.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND sc.spanmin IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY s.healtheval
),
with_average AS (
  SELECT status, total_scans, gb_per_minute,
         AVG(gb_per_minute) OVER () AS average_gb_per_minute
  FROM status_rates
)
SELECT status, total_scans, gb_per_minute,
       gb_per_minute - average_gb_per_minute AS above_average
FROM with_average
WHERE gb_per_minute > average_gb_per_minute;
